format: manufacturing technician posting, ALL CAPS headings, '*' bullets, physical requirements
note: ALL CAPS headings followed by lists. 'POSITION SUMMARY' is not vocabulary and fails R2.2 rule 4 (plain line follows; ALL CAPS alone does not waive it): pre-heading body. 'ESSENTIAL DUTIES' is not an exact vocabulary entry: unknown heading (unscored either way). 'WORKING CONDITIONS' is unknown with no skills; 'Must be able to lift/stand' lines bind nothing. 'Willingness to learn SolidWorks' is hypothetical even inside PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: no group, so the resume's SolidWorks is not found. Resume: 'Currently learning PLC troubleshooting and root cause analysis' makes both hypothetical (R2.8.5); 'zero ESD-related failures', 'no overtime was needed', 'never had a nonconformance' are not negations.

Manufacturing Technician II (Electronics Assembly)
Shift: Days, 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.

POSITION SUMMARY
Supports production of power conversion modules for EV chargers and industrial drives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES
* Build, test and troubleshoot sub-assemblies per work instructions
* Monitor control charts and escalate out-of-control conditions
* Participate in kaizen events and daily 5S
* Perform basic preventive maintenance on pneumatics and conveyors

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
* 2+ years in a manufacturing or electronics assembly environment
* Basic computer skills, including entering transactions in SAP
* Ability to follow a quality management system (ISO 9001)

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
* IPC-A-610 certification
* Experience with PLC troubleshooting
* Familiarity with root cause analysis tools such as 5 Whys
* Willingness to learn SolidWorks for fixture design

WORKING CONDITIONS
* Must be able to lift 35 lbs and wear ESD protection
* Must be able to stand for extended periods
